summary: Docs: the crate-validate CHANGELOG entry says 'cargo tree -p atip -e normal lists 35 crates instead of 103'; since this change made sha2 a normal dependency (and crate-plan reuses it) the same command lists 44 (I ran it at 194a1457), so the published count is wrong and the probe's figure (36) is too. The brief accepts sha2; the number was not updated. Blast radius: documentation only; atip-probe's test asserts only that jsonschema is absent, so it still passes.
